digital_purchases_content.question: In this screenshot, is there any visible indication or interface for purchasing/selling digital goods, cash rewards, gift cards, play-to-earn features, convertible cryptocurrency rewards, or issuance of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)?

digital_purchases_includes.question: In this screenshot, which of the following digital purchase or reward types are visibly present or promoted? (Select all that apply) (Purchases of digital goods: real-money purchases of virtual items/currency to enhance experience/progress; Cash Convertible Rewards: cash, real-world items of value, convertible crypto, play-to-earn mechanics; Issuance of transferable digital assets: minting NFTs or similar)

options.value: Cash Convertible Rewards - Cash rewards, real-world items of significant monetary value, convertible cryptocurrency rewards or other play-to-earn mechanics
Issuance (e.g., minting) of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)

(Chance-based: purchaser does not know exact outcome beforehand.)
